evidence.claim: The paper claims HIVE-3D significantly outperforms previous approaches and shows consistently strong performance across all metrics, but Table 1 shows TRELLIS outperforms HIVE-3D on IoU with a ≈14% gap.
evidence.excerpt: The abstract, introduction and §5.2 claim that HIVE-3D "significantly outperforms previous approaches" and shows "consistently strong performance across all metrics", but Table 1 explicitly shows TRELLIS outperforming HIVE-3D on IoU (0.8603 vs. 0.7449 — a ≈14% relative gap that the paper itself bolds in TRELLIS's favour). The same overclaim recurs in the conclusion ("outperforms existing methods in terms of 3D scene generation quality"). Why it matters: IoU is one of only three geometry metrics reported in Table 1, so a >14 point deficit is not compatible with "consistently strong across all metrics".
